reviews.text:
They carefully examine even minor symptoms.
I'm grateful.
Dr. Ikeda is very caring and attentive to the needs of patients and their families. Thanks to him, all five of my pets have lived long lives, and I am very grateful ♡

They looked after my cat, who had been with me for 16 years, until the end.
When you have them look after your cat during your appointment, you are asking them to do everything for you, and I am very grateful that they took such good care of him, even shampooing and feeding him, which I was unable to do at the time because I was so busy.
Thank you so much.

There are kind vets here!! 😁
The nurses and groomers are all very kind too.

Some people are posting incorrectly because it's a shift system!!
